description: Create a scoped autonomous payment session bound to your agent. The user pre-funds a dedicated child Safe and installs an on-chain spending policy (single pinned recipient, per-execution and per-period caps) with a passkey in the Moneda app. After that you can call agent_execute_payment repeatedly within the policy — no per-payment approval. This call does NOT activate the session: it returns a counterfactual child Safe address and an activation deep link the user must open in the Moneda app. Poll get_agent_session until status is ACTIVE before executing.

currency.description: Stablecoin denomination for the session (USD or EUR).

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry. After this, executions are rejected and the session can no longer be used.

fundingAmount.description: Optional initial parent→child funding amount, in user-facing units. The child Safe balance is the hard ceiling on worst-case loss.

maxAmountPerExecution.description: Max per single payment, in user-facing units (e.g. '25.00'). Must be > 0 and ≤ maxAmountPerPeriod.

maxAmountPerPeriod.description: Max total spend per rolling period, in user-facing units (e.g. '100.00'). Must be > 0.

periodSeconds.description: Length of the spending period in seconds (e.g. 86400 for a daily cap).

recipient.description: The single crypto recipient address (0x…) pinned for this session. Phase 1 is crypto-to-crypto; every execution must go to this address.

name: create_agent_session
